## GLM 5.2 API

GLM 5.2 is a large language model by Z.ai, available on the Venice API as `zai-org-glm-5-2`. Private and end-to-end encrypted variants are available.

GLM-5.2, the successor to GLM-5.1, is a large language model developed by Z.ai, featuring significantly enhanced reasoning capabilities, improved instruction following, and support for multiple languages. Supports a longer context window than GLM-5.1 for processing extensive text and detailed analysis with fast inference speed.

### GLM 5.2 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zai-org-glm-5-2` | Standard | Private | $1.40 / $4.40 per 1M |
| `e2ee-glm-5-2-p` | E2EE | E2EE | $1.75 / $5.75 per 1M |

### GLM 5.2 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Z.ai |
| Released | Jun 16, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private, E2EE |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, high, max |
| Served precision | FP8 |

### How to use the GLM 5.2 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "zai-org-glm-5-2"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "zai-org-glm-5-2",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "max"
  }'
```
